changes.text: 要不要修京通铁路，朝中有了争执。《清史稿·张之洞传》记：「會海軍衙門奏請修京通鐵路，臺諫爭陳鐵路之害，請停辦」。海军衙门主张修，台谏（负责进言、弹劾的言官）争陈铁路之害、请停办。传文紧接着又记了另外两种主张：「翁同龢等請試修邊地，便用兵；徐會灃請改修德州濟寧路，利漕運」，其后录有本文传主张之洞的议奏。至于台谏所说的害具体是哪几条、海军衙门的理由为何，传文都没有记。

The proposed Beijing-Tongzhou railway drew opposition at court. Zhang Zhidong's biography in the Draft History of the Qing records it this way (here and throughout, quotations from the Chinese are our own translations): "When the Naval Office petitioned to build the Beijing-Tongzhou railway, the censors pressed the harms of railways and asked that the project be halted." The Naval Office stood for building; the censors - the court's officials charged with remonstrance and impeachment - pressed the harms and asked for a stop. The biography then records two further proposals: Weng Tonghe and others asked to try building in the frontier regions, for ease of moving troops; Xu Huifeng asked to build a Dezhou-Jining line instead, for the benefit of grain transport. After that it records the memorial of Zhang Zhidong, the subject of this biography. Which harms the censors meant, and what reasons the Naval Office gave, the biography does not record.
张之洞针对这几种主张上了一份议奏。他的议奏所论是一条以河为界、分南北两段的线路；传文所录未说明它与京通线的关系。议奏中明确排出了目标次序：「修路之利，以通土貨、厚民生為最大，徵兵、轉餉次之」。目标的轻重被明明白白摆上桌面——作者认为，这个排序是这篇议奏最容易被略过、也最见功夫的地方。

Zhang Zhidong answered these proposals with a memorial. The line it discusses is divided by the river into a northern and a southern section; the biography's record does not say how it relates to the Beijing-Tongzhou line. The memorial sets out an explicit ranking of goals: "In building a railway, the greatest benefit lies in moving local goods and enriching the people's livelihood; raising troops and forwarding supplies come second." The relative weight of the goals is laid plainly on the table. In the author's view, that ranking is the easiest thing to skim past in this memorial, and the place where the real craft sits.
作者提出的替代选择（传文所录议奏中未见，属反事实）：议奏已主张「分段分年成之」，但传文所录议奏中没有先试修一小段、看运量与扰民程度再定其余各段的设计；传文记翁同龢等曾「請試修邊地」，但那是为「便用兵」，不是先修一段、以运量和扰民程度决定其余各段。另一种做法是把「利」逐条配上可核对的口径，让反对者逐条检验，这在传文所录议奏中也未见。这两种设计是作者提出的比较项，不是传文所录议奏里的内容。

Alternatives the author offers (not found in the memorial as the biography records it, therefore counterfactual): the memorial already proposes completing the line section by section, year by year, but the recorded text has no design for building a short stretch first and letting freight volumes and the degree of disruption decide the rest. The biography does record that Weng Tonghe and others asked to try building in the frontier regions, but that was for ease of moving troops, not a matter of building one stretch first and letting freight volumes and disruption decide the remaining sections. Another option would be to attach a checkable yardstick to each "benefit," so opponents could test them one by one, and that too does not appear in the memorial as recorded. Both designs are comparison items the author raises, not part of the memorial as the biography records it.
作者的一种读法是，这份议奏至少包含以下四个部分（另有南北接续的图景）：排目标次序（通土货、厚民生最大，征兵转饷次之），列逐条的「利」并编号（共七条），提出「分段分年成之」，落实到官职（北路直隶总督、南路湖广总督、河南巡抚为副）。作者认为，这样写可能把争论从“有没有害”引向“这些逐条的「利」成不成立、这三位督抚之职扛不扛得动”。

One reading is that the memorial includes at least four components (besides the picture of connections): a ranking of goals (moving goods and enriching livelihoods greatest, raising troops and forwarding supplies next); a numbered, item-by-item list of benefits, seven in all; a proposal to complete the line section by section, year by year; and responsibility assigned to offices (north to the Governor-General of Zhili, south to the Governor-General of Huguang, the Governor of Henan as deputy). In the author's view, writing it this way may steer the argument away from "is it harmful" toward "do these itemized benefits hold, and can these three offices carry them."
再往下是分工：「北路責之直隸總督，南路責之湖廣總督，副以河南巡撫」。北路归直隶总督，南路归湖广总督，河南巡抚做副手。谁扛哪一段，写得清清楚楚；作者认为，这样没有留下各段无人专责的余地。

Then the division of labor: "Let the northern section be the charge of the Governor-General of Zhili, and the southern section the charge of the Governor-General of Huguang, assisted by the Governor of Henan." Who carries which stretch is written out plainly. In the author's view, this leaves no room for a section that no one is specifically responsible for.

把“传文没有记载”“议奏中也未见”收窄为“传文所录议奏中未见”；并注明翁同龢等请试修边地是为便用兵，不是以运量与扰民程度决定其余各段；英文同步，ev 补 E18。
